text: The dispatcher simplification removes the Windows-specific compatibility route. Accepted showNewAlertNotification selects native or custom notification directly from mail.biff.use_system_alert. The inspected native failure branch does not open the custom fallback. The current test named revert_to_newmailalert now selects the custom route by preference. Preserve the route and failure meanings; that test name is not evidence of a runtime fallback. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Choose the notification route from the preference without inventing a fallback
